description: Nuzlocke/Gen1. A compact deterministic fork that demonstrates REAL permadeath culling. Accepts the forced layer-1 catch (Nuzlocke forces both layer-1 nodes to CATCH, bundle.deobfuscated.js:53419-53427) so the party is two strong, then WINS a battle in which a member faints -- which is the only branch that culls, since runBattleScreen's fainted-cull and held-item release sit inside the win branch opened at 81278 and the loss `else` (81388-81430) never touches state.team. The pre-existing `nuzlocke_gen1_loss` scenario wipes with a one-Pokemon party, so its team length never decreases and it can never earn the permadeath tag; this scenario is what does. It then loses and terminates. Also covers Nuzlocke init, the Nuzlocke-only layer-1 map shape, an item decline, and game over. Route derived by a bounded deterministic search over real source runs -- see PLAN.md's M3.1 record.
